article.title: Imperfectivo para invitación
article.chapter: Imperativo, petición e invitación — Повелительное наклонение, просьба и приглашение

claims.summary: Timberlake describes the Russian imperfective imperative as a form that can issue an invitation and gives Заходите, раздевайтесь as examples; the entry is restricted to this invitational use and does not claim a universal politeness rule.
